global_render_acceptance: Preserve exact selected R1 visual family and scale relationship: orange/yellow frame, dark rollers, gray supported plates, blue machinery/base; no automatic resizing of chosen line.
Preserve Character1 and selected R4 ordinary pickups; fish and animal meat can vary by authored presentation type/size.
Each listed cell has actual visible geometry in the new set, labeled direction and compatible item form; an unseen verbal claim does not count.
Use meaningful opposing angles and close-ups of mating surfaces; show normal/full or held states where listed.
Same physical item/variant size through carrying, belt, dock, stock and counter; fit the largest accepted item and show spacing without shrink-to-fit.
Visible supports, matched endpoints and clear service controls; preserve four distinct storage ports and two open camp gates.
No register or random staffed clerk; goods and cash stay separate in self-service counter views.
All canonical IDs, recipes, manual-only interfaces and disabled food-assembly scope remain unchanged; no extra economy/spawn claims.

Apply current REFERENCE_ACCEPTANCE_POLICY without weaker override: exact unrounded 10.0 for applicable reference-sensitive/style critics, at least 9.9 for any additional reference-sensitive dimension, at least 9.5 for other applicable dimensions, all mandatory evidence/checks passed, no averaging and zero unapproved deviations. Missing evidence is BLOCKED.
Static render approval never proves conveyor cycles, collisions, pathfinding, exact inventory/cash conservation or runtime integration; separate candidate playback/tests remain mandatory.
